units.source_text: 两人听见上面传来一片骚乱声，就慌慌张张地登上石磴。

en.t: Hearing a commotion from above, the two of them hurried up the stone steps.

units.source_text: 抬头一看，高处客栈二三楼房间的拉窗差不多都打开了，人们跑到敞亮的走廊上观看着火场面。

en.t: When they looked up, nearly all the sliding windows in the second- and third-floor rooms of the high inn were open, and people had come out into the bright corridors to watch the fire.

units.source_text: 庭院一个角落里，一排菊花的枯枝，说不清是借着客栈的灯光还是星光，浮现出它的轮廓，令人不禁感到那上面映着火光。

en.t: In one corner of the garden, a row of withered chrysanthemum stalks, outlined by either the inn lights or the starlight, made it seem as though the firelight were reflected on them.

units.source_text: 就在那排菊花后面，也站着一些人。

en.t: Some people were standing behind that row of chrysanthemums too.

units.source_text: 三四个客栈伙计从岛村他俩头顶上跌跌撞撞地滚落下来。

en.t: Three or four inn attendants came stumbling down from above Shimamura and his companion, almost tumbling over them.
Komako raised her voice and asked:
